_note: Facts about each club, read from its UW Rec description or HuskyLink mission (only what those say). Fills a listed club's About tab; officers who claim a club can change it. Keys: focus, joining, experience, competes, meets, location, how_to_join, dues.

UW Men's Ultimate Frisbee Club.how_to_join: Players of all skill levels are welcome. Follow @sundodgers on Instagram for tryouts and practices.

UW Men's Volleyball Club.how_to_join: Three teams: A and B travel and compete, C is the developmental team.

UW Women's Rugby Club.meets: 2-3 practices a week, fall to spring quarter
UW Women's Rugby Club.how_to_join: No experience needed. Practice times and rookie clinics are on their Instagram.

UW Women's Soccer Club.how_to_join: Tryouts at the start of fall quarter every year.

UW Women's Ultimate Frisbee Club.meets: Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays; season November to May

UW Badminton Club.how_to_join: Players of all skill levels are welcome.

UW Canoe Family.how_to_join: Email canoefamily@gmail.com to come to a meeting.

UW Climbing Club.how_to_join: A varsity team that competes and a recreational team for climbers of all levels, beginners included.

UW Cycling Club.how_to_join: New members always welcome, novices included. Join a ride.

UW Equestrian Club.meets: Weekly meetings, lessons at a nearby barn

UW Roundnet Club.how_to_join: Open to all skill levels: come to a pick-up game.

UW Running Club.how_to_join: Just show up at the Quad at 5 PM. All abilities welcome.

UW Skiing Club.meets: Weekly training, five races in winter quarter

UW Squash Club.how_to_join: Beginners to experienced players: they meet regularly to play.

UW Swimming Club.how_to_join: Swimmers of all levels; you'll be asked to show you can swim. Meets are optional.

UW Table Tennis Club.how_to_join: Complete beginners to competitive players. Info on their socials.

UW Tennis Club.how_to_join: Practices are for all levels; the tournament team holds tryouts at the start of the year.

UW Triathlon Club.how_to_join: From brand-new swimmers to national-level triathletes.

Union Bay Rowing Club.meets: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri, 7-9 AM (not in summer)
Union Bay Rowing Club.how_to_join: Rowers and coxswains of all experience levels, never rowed included.

UW Aikido Club.how_to_join: Beginner friendly, martial arts experience or not.

UW Archery Club.how_to_join: New members all year round, all levels. Come to a practice in the IMA Archery Room (#106).

UW Boxing Club.how_to_join: No experience needed. Tryouts every fall: watch their Instagram and DM them with questions.

UW Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Club.how_to_join: The club is for people with experience. Beginners: sign up for the BJJ class through UW Recreation.

UW Judo Club.how_to_join: All skill levels welcome; they help pay for tournaments.

UW Shotokan Karate Club.how_to_join: Most members start with the Shotokan Karate Sports and Fitness class, then join the club.

UW Wrestling Club.how_to_join: Open to all skill levels: stop by a practice.

UW Wushu Club.how_to_join: Everyone welcome: stop by and practice.

Breakfast Ball Golf Club.how_to_join: All golfers, any level: they provide instruction and equipment.

Eta Mu Beta Flag Football Club.how_to_join: For members of the Husky Marching Band.

Figure Skating at UW.meets: Group practices at Kraken Community Iceplex
Figure Skating at UW.how_to_join: No skating experience needed. Email them if you're interested.

Hacky Sack Club.how_to_join: All skill levels welcome. Follow @uwhackysack on Instagram.

Husky Fly Fishing Club.meets: Fishing trips, fly tying and casting lessons

Husky MMA.how_to_join: Join their Discord: it's the best way to get in touch.

Husky Wiffle Club.how_to_join: No Wiffle Ball or baseball experience needed.

Husky Winter Sports.how_to_join: Skiers and snowboarders of all levels.

QueerTrans Sports Club.how_to_join: Queer beginners welcome: come try new sports. Join their Discord.

The Hiking Club at UW.how_to_join: All skill levels, from never-hiked to certified dirtbag.
